description: Defines the FileFieldItemList class for managing file field items in Drupal, including methods for handling file usage on save, delete, and revision delete.

classes.name: FileFieldItemList
classes.description: Represents a configurable entity file field, managing file usage and references within Drupal.

methods.name: defaultValuesForm
methods.description: Provides default values form for the file field (empty implementation).

methods.name: postSave
methods.description: Handles file usage updates after saving the entity, including adding new usage and removing old usage for files.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes file usage references when the entity is deleted or translation is removed.

methods.name: deleteRevision
methods.description: Handles file usage cleanup when a revision of the entity is deleted.
